name: prd-designz
description: Product design and UI prototype skills for DESIGN.md generation, existing-project style extraction, reusable UI assets, and project-consistent prototyping.

interface.shortDescription: Design specs, existing-project style extraction, reusable UI assets, and prototype workflows.
interface.longDescription: PRD Designz supports new-product DESIGN.md and HTML prototype generation, lightweight DESIGN.md extraction from existing front-end projects, reusable React/Tailwind UI asset extraction for project-specific prototype skills, and project-consistent PRD/sketch-to-prototype workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use design-md to create a DESIGN.md and high-fidelity prototype for a new product or page direction.
Use project-design-md to extract a lightweight DESIGN.md from an existing front-end project, screenshots, running pages, or style configuration.
Use project-ui-skill-builder to extract an existing project's DESIGN.md and reusable React/Tailwind assets, then generate a project-specific prototype skill.
Use project-ui-prototyper to turn a PRD, page request, flow, screenshot, wireframe, or sketch into a prototype that matches an existing project UI system.
Generate prototypes that follow either a new design direction or an extracted project UI system.
